subject: Silverpoint: acceleration path proposal for enterprise activation
messages:
From: Ethan Rouse <ethan.rouse@silverpoint.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@silverpoint.com
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prod readiness asks and gating items for Silverpoint launch

Hi Jasmine / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — Silverpoint is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the model fidelity shown in the POC. Procurement asked me to put the key technical asks in writing so we can lock them into the SOW and the mutual action plan. High level asks below:

- Deterministic audit snapshot: we need an exported snapshot that guarantees consistent inference inputs/outputs for any 30-day window for audit reviewers. Exports must include prompt+response, model version, and route details.
- Warm-path residency for peak trading windows: ability to guarantee a warm pool / affinity for our tenant between 13:00–17:00 ET on business days for market hours.
- Per-tenant isolation of telemetry & KV cache TTLs (we can't share prefix cache with other tenants for compliance reasons).
- SLA: p95 < 120ms, p99 < 300ms during warm-path window, with a contractual rollback path if not met.

Attached is a draft SOW and a high-level risk checklist from our compliance team. We need these items reflected in the contract (or a clear delivery plan) before legal signs. Can you confirm whether Redwood can commit to an activation path that includes a residency guarantee and a reproducible audit export? If not fully commit, we need a clear timeline and gating milestones.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Rouse
Head of Platform Partnerships
Silverpoint Financial

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ethan.rouse@silverpoint.com
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prod readiness asks and gating items for Silverpoint launch

Ben / Irene — looping you in. Silverpoint just dropped a fairly prescriptive set of gating items (attached SOW + compliance checklist). Key asks they want in the SOW or a delivery plan: deterministic audit snapshots, warm-path residency during ET trading hours, and per-tenant cache isolation.

Quick asks from our side:
- Product: can we scope a minimal deliverable that satisfies audit snapshot requirements (format, retention, export frequency) and flag the major unknowns?
- Eng: high-level feasibility on producing a warm-path residency guarantee and per-tenant KV cache isolation; if residency requires reserved capacity we should call that out as a dedicated-capacity ask.

Procurement is asking for dates — they want milestones in the SOW rather than a vague "roadmap" note. I've attached the SOW and Silverpoint's checklist. Ben, can you confirm Silverpoint's timeline pressure (they implied a June go-live)?

I'll draft a short mutual action plan once we have rough estimates.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ethan.rouse@silverpoint.com
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prod readiness asks and gating items for Silverpoint launch

+1 on urgency — Silverpoint is a seat-of-influence deal and legal pushed hard. They called out June as a target.

I put together a draft MAP (attached — MAP_Silverpoint_v1.pdf) that breaks the asks into three deliverables:
1) Audit export v1 (format + retention + scheduled export) — target milestone: 2026-05-20
2) Isolation & cache policy (per-tenant TTL + config) — prototype milestone: 2026-05-27, production: 2026-06-15
3) Residency guarantee (warm pool during ET trading hours) — exploratory/design: 2026-05-03, pilot (limited warm pool): 2026-06-01

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_Silverpoint_v1.pdf

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2026 15:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Prod readiness asks and gating items for Silverpoint launch

Forwarding the thread to Engineering and Runtime leads (see internal snippet below). High-level notes from Product after quick triage: we can aim for the Audit export v1 by the May 20 milestone if we scope it to an S3-delivered tarball containing time-windowed JSONL with model metadata and route ids. Major caveats: we need to define the export schema and retention policy now.

Isolation & cache: per-tenant TTLs are relatively low risk if we allocate config knobs and guardrails; full tenant KV separation will be heavier (may require dedicated shards or namespace enforcement). That drives cost and could push production beyond June unless we accept a pilot that uses logical isolation + strict TTLs.

Residency guarantee: this is the riskiest ask. To meet a contractual warm-pool guarantee we likely need reserved capacity (Dedicated) for the critical windows, plus a warm-up protocol for model weights and KV priming. Engineering needs to confirm resource cost and a fallback policy (e.g., automatic routing to compatible model variant with a defined latency uplift).

Action items for us:
- Engineering: provide T-shirt estimates for the three deliverables (Audit v1, Isolation prototype, Residency pilot) by 2026-04-28. Highlight required infra (dedicated GPUs, reserved capacity) and any long-lead items.
- Product: define the export schema draft by 2026-04-26 and confirm retention/PII gating.
- Sales/CS: confirm Silverpoint's commercial willingness to pay for reserved capacity if required.

Irene Choi
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference
